verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a local embedded development service with a Web UI for viewing sample workflow executions, and a CLI to monitor and debug applications. Together these give a way to run and observe workflows locally before production. However, nothing in the pack documents pinning or mocking data, or a per-step view of activity inputs and outputs. missing for 10: pinned/sample-data test mode, documented per-step input/output inspection, independent hands-on corroboration of pre-production testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test a workflow with sample or pinned data and inspect each step's input and output before going live

citations.quote: Try Temporal Web UI by opening http://localhost:8233 for viewing your sample workflows executing on Temporal.
Use it to manage, monitor, and debug Temporal applications, plus run an embedded development service when you need fast local feedback.
This starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your local machine.
